notes: 扩展按住拖动、多指手势、文字编辑和系统操作；支持分段读取长文与界面树，由 AI 按设备实际能力使用并核实结果。
新增授权范围内的文件收发与临时只读分享。默认使用 Airtap 工作目录；需要其他文件夹时，由你在系统中选择。
首次接入可在必要权限就绪后继续准备邀请；连接提示区分自动恢复与需要处理的具体步骤。通知权限恢复后可继续原连接，无需重新配对。
加强服务连接的证书校验，并在新邀请中附带接入说明与 CLI 的文件校验信息。安全连接无法验证时保留配对，提示检查更新。
已安装用户直接覆盖更新，保留原 AI 配对；无需先卸载或清除数据。主动停止或解除连接后，不会自动恢复控制。
当前仍是 Android 公开测试版。机型、个人 AI、跨 App 任务和后台恢复的验证范围分别记录，不代表所有设备或所有 App 均已验证。

relay.limit_scope: Configured registered-device limit, not a demonstrated 1000 concurrent active-device capacity.

website.request_retry_policy: Unchanged stdlib HTTPS verification, redirects disabled; at most one retry per idempotent GET/HEAD, only for timeout/connection reset.
website.network_limit: One local network vantage point. Final read-only verification passed after one bounded timeout retry; prior failures were not erased. No certificate-validation relaxation or security rule change.

checks.includes: Host fixtures, actual workerd/CLI protocol tests and Android compile/lint; not a replacement for physical tests.

earlier_failures.kind: connection-closing fixture missing TLS classification stub

device_and_ai.physical_maintenance: Same-signer USB in-place upgrade from37 to38; no clear/uninstall/pairing reset or network change. Maintenance is separate from Muse task execution.
device_and_ai.muse_result: Original pair and hash-checked CLI.8; actual WPS two-line text display, new note save/reopen and HOME; media volume zero before/after.
device_and_ai.failures: Retain upgrade ping deadline, notification-state lag, protected Airtap/window transition recovery and missing non-decisive image attachments in their respective records.

source_distribution: Use the reviewed allowlist and a newly frozen export, never publish the private Git history directly. Export and extracted-package verification are recorded alongside the immutable source artifact.
not_claimed: Independent ordinary-user first installation or code38 first-time personal-AI bootstrap
Code38 long-idle/multi-day or all network/device regression
Instinct and other personal-AI code38 acceptance
All App workflows or all atomic capabilities verified
All certificates/runtimes universally safe or proof an attack did not occur
private_materials_excluded: Signing keys, credentials, device and connection identifiers, raw phone/Muse screenshots, logs and archives, deployment configuration
github_ci: Existing cloud jobs failed before steps because account billing/spend limit; local passing checks are recorded separately. No billing settings changed.
